name: @titan/web
description: Project Titan — playable 2D pixel idle-MMORPG client. Mobile-first, PC compatible. Drives @titan/engine in the browser.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/app.js && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp -r assets dist/assets
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && npx -y wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=project-titan
